source: Current GMod feature registry and menu controls; gamemode-specific options depend on the active server.

items.label: Aim FOV
items.desc: Set the angle in which targets can be selected.

items.label: Hitbox Selection
items.desc: Choose the aim point or scan several hitboxes.
settings: Head, Chest, Stomach, Pelvis, Nearest, Hitscan

items.label: Target Priority
items.desc: Choose how eligible targets are ranked.

items.label: Shot Delay
items.desc: Set a delay before firing.

items.label: Hit Chance
items.desc: Set the required hit-chance threshold.

items.label: Minimum Damage
items.desc: Set the minimum damage threshold for a shot.

items.label: Damage Override Value
items.desc: Choose the damage threshold used while the override bind is active.

items.label: Target Lock Time
items.desc: Configure how long target lock persists.

items.label: Conditional Hitboxes
items.desc: Choose separate hitboxes for standing, moving and airborne targets.

items.label: Aim FOV & Hitbox
items.desc: Set the aim radius and preferred hitbox.

items.label: Smoothing Controls
items.desc: Adjust smoothing strength, smooth-in and random smoothing.

items.label: RCS Strength
items.desc: Set horizontal and vertical recoil-control strength independently.

items.label: Switch Delay
items.desc: Set the delay before switching to another target.

items.label: Triggerbot Settings
items.desc: Configure firing delay, hitbox filtering and burst time.

items.label: Multipoint Scale
items.desc: Adjust how far sample points spread around a hitbox.

items.label: Backtrack Window
items.desc: Set the history window and record selection mode.

items.label: Aim Smoothing
items.desc: Adjust how quickly aim moves toward a target.

items.label: Pitch & Yaw
items.desc: Choose angle modes and tune custom pitch, yaw offset, jitter range and spin speed.

items.label: Fake Lag Settings
items.desc: Configure tick count, activation method and fluctuation limits.

items.label: Fake Model Material
items.desc: Customize the material and color of the fake model.

items.label: Box Settings
items.desc: Configure box style, thickness, fill and outline.

items.label: Bar Settings
items.desc: Customize health, armor and ammo bars, including position and size.

items.label: Text Settings
items.desc: Adjust text size, position and display style.

items.label: Line Settings
items.desc: Tune skeleton, snapline and line-of-sight styles and thickness.

items.label: Feature Colors
items.desc: Set colors beside individual controls.

items.label: Entity Selection
items.desc: Select which entity classes appear in ESP.

items.label: Materials & Colors
items.desc: Choose materials, base colors and overlay materials for each chams group.

items.label: Nightmode Brightness & Tint
items.desc: Adjust world brightness and red, green and blue tint.

items.label: Bullet Tracer Settings
items.desc: Set tracer style, duration, thickness and impact size.

items.label: Camera FOV Value
items.desc: Adjust the camera field of view.

items.label: Viewmodel FOV Value
items.desc: Adjust the field of view used for the weapon model.

items.label: Viewmodel Position
items.desc: Offset the weapon along the X, Y and Z axes.

items.label: Radar Layout
items.desc: Choose a square or circular radar and adjust its size.

items.label: Range & Markers
items.desc: Set radar range, marker size, name size and the number of range rings.

items.label: Radar Colors
items.desc: Customize the radar background and player marker colors.

items.label: Player List
items.desc: Browse players and manage player-specific preferences.

items.label: Script Library
items.desc: Browse local Lua files and select a script.

items.label: Create Script
items.desc: Create a named Lua file from the menu.

items.label: Load Script
items.desc: Run a selected local script in the client Lua environment.

items.label: Edit Script
items.desc: Open a selected script in an external editor.

items.label: Full-page Editor
items.desc: Edit client-side Lua with syntax highlighting and a script dropdown.

items.label: Per-file Drafts
items.desc: Keep editor drafts when switching scripts or tabs.

items.label: Undo & Redo
items.desc: Undo or restore edits; clear the editor from the toolbar.

items.label: Run Lua
items.desc: Run the editor contents as client-side Lua while loaded into a game.

items.label: Run Console
items.desc: Send the editor contents as a game console command.

items.label: Lua Dumper
items.desc: Configure Lua dumping and inspect dump statistics.

items.label: Net Logger
items.desc: Inspect logged network messages and clear the log.

items.label: Server Information
items.desc: View server information and copy the server IP.

items.label: Entity Dump
items.desc: Save entity information to a local file.

items.label: Folder Shortcuts
items.desc: Open scripts, dumps, configs and the Scooby folder.

items.label: Automatic UI Scale
items.desc: Size the menu for the current game resolution.

items.label: Manual UI Scale
items.desc: Choose a preset or adjust the menu scale from 25% to 200%.

items.label: Overlay Scale
items.desc: Scale HUD overlays independently with automatic or manual sizing.

items.label: Resizable Menu
items.desc: Resize the interface to fit your layout.

items.label: Menu Open Keys
items.desc: Change the keys used to open the menu.

items.label: Color Picker
items.desc: Edit feature colors using RGB, HEX and an alpha slider.

items.label: Language Packs
items.desc: Choose from 23 JSON language packs. Partial translations fall back to English.

items.label: Reload Languages
items.desc: Reload locally edited language files.

items.label: Feature Search
items.desc: Find features from the search icon at the top of the menu.

items.label: Favorites
items.desc: Keep frequently used controls in the favorites view.
settings: Hover a feature and press F to add or remove it

items.label: Keyboard & Mouse Binds
items.desc: Assign a key or mouse button to a feature.

items.label: Activation Modes
items.desc: Choose how a feature responds to its hotkey.
settings: Always, Toggle, Hold, Hold to Disable

items.label: Hotkey Browser
items.desc: Search bindings, filter by category and show only assigned controls.

items.label: Clear Bind
items.desc: Remove a key assignment from a feature.

items.label: Config Browser
items.desc: Browse saved profiles and create or rename a config.

items.label: Load & Save
items.desc: Load a selected profile or save the current settings.

items.label: Auto Save
items.desc: Automatically save changes to the active config when enabled.

items.label: Default Config
items.desc: Choose the profile loaded on startup.

items.label: Clipboard Import & Export
items.desc: Import a config from the clipboard or copy a profile for sharing.

items.label: Reset & Delete
items.desc: Reset settings to defaults or remove a selected config.

items.label: Refresh Config List
items.desc: Reload the list of saved profiles.
